summary: The statement and proof are valid. The lattice-point census and exact endpoint parity and midpoint counts hold for arbitrary nonempty label subfamilies, including m=1 and the minimum private-group size two. The Sárközy–Szemerédi input matches Theorem 1.1 and the independent-sign definition in the cited primary source; its use after deleting one coefficient and the separate m=1 case are justified. The retained-band mass, stock inequality, reflection and Hölder reductions, dyadic boundary treatment, and numerical constants all check. The actual core is complete and satisfies the accepted one-step theorem, with the conditional normalizer and probability map explicitly correct, so the complementary regimes establish both original-law cubic bounds.
